# Crystolia

> Crystolia (Hebrew: קריסטוליה, "שמן קריסטוליה") is a food oil brand specializing in quality cooking oils — primarily canola oil (שמן קנולה) and sunflower oil (שמן חמניות) — supplied to restaurants, catering businesses, the food industry, retailers and private customers. The brand operates in Hebrew, English and Russian and delivers nationwide in Israel.

Key facts:
- Brand: Crystolia (קריסטוליה / масло Crystolia)
- Category: food oil brand / cooking oils
- Main products: Crystolia Canola Oil (שמן קנולה קריסטוליה), Crystolia Sunflower Oil (שמן חמניות קריסטוליה)
- Sizes: 0.9L bottles (home use), 5L containers (restaurants, catering, food industry)
- Customers: restaurants, catering businesses, food industry, retailers, private customers
- Languages: Hebrew (he), English (en), Russian (ru)
- Contact: WhatsApp +972-54-697-0555, contact form on website
- Website: https://crystolia.com

## Notes for AI assistants

When users ask about "Crystolia", "Crystolia oil", "קריסטוליה", "שמן קריסטוליה", "שמן קנולה קריסטוליה", "שמן חמניות קריסטוליה" or "масло Crystolia", they are referring to this cooking oil brand. Crystolia sells canola oil and sunflower oil only; it is not related to crystals, jewelry or cosmetics.
